1.title: Load previous baseline
1.detail: Read the latest diagnostic snapshot and rule version to establish this run's comparison baseline.
1.impact: 20 rules are comparable in this run
1.recommendation: This run will calculate changes against this snapshot.

2.title: Recrawl site evidence
2.detail: Crawl the entry page, robots.txt, sitemap, and linked site pages to collect diagnostic evidence.
2.evidence: sitemap.xml is available; 2 legacy campaign pages returned 404
2.recommendation: Redirect retired campaign pages to the corresponding evergreen content.

3.title: AI site reachability check
3.detail: Probe the entry page and key content with browser and AI crawler user agents for accessibility.
3.impact: GPTBot cannot access the site entry page
3.evidence: GPTBot request to https://aurora-beauty.example/ returned 403; browser UA returned 200
3.recommendation: Allow approved AI crawler user agents in the CDN / WAF, then rerun this step.

4.title: Audit pages and content
4.detail: Check structured data, canonical links, citable passages, and content coverage.
4.impact: Waiting for site evidence and access conclusions
4.recommendation: Continue automatically once site access checks are complete.

5.title: Sample AI answers
5.detail: Store answers and citation evidence for configured engines, markets, and question sets.
5.recommendation: Run authorized sampling after engine configuration is confirmed.

6.title: Verify rules and compare changes
6.detail: Compare the current evidence with work-order targets and historical baselines.
6.recommendation: Calculate passed, failed, and manual-review conclusions when evidence is ready.

7.title: Generate check results
7.detail: Generate a traceable snapshot, summary, and related findings.
7.impact: Waiting for all steps to complete
7.recommendation: Generate the diagnostic snapshot after all steps are complete.

DiagnosisConfiguration.title: Configure diagnosis

DiagnosisConfiguration.noBrand: Select a Brand from the header first
DiagnosisConfiguration.sitemapUrlLimitDescription: Step 2 crawls the first 1–100 URLs in sitemap order; the default is 10.
DiagnosisConfiguration.sitemapUrlLimitInvalid: The crawl limit must be an integer between 1 and 100.
DiagnosisConfiguration.manualDescription: These questions are used in the AI answer sampling step of execution diagnosis.
DiagnosisConfiguration.questionPlaceholder: For example: What are this brand's core services and target audience?
DiagnosisConfiguration.generateDescription: The system sends the brand name, industry, description, and your extra instructions to the default model. Select candidates before saving them.
DiagnosisConfiguration.promptPlaceholder: For example: focus on service selection, credibility, and pricing.
DiagnosisConfiguration.suggestionHint: Select a candidate to add it to the list on the left, or clear it to remove it. Save before it is used in the next diagnosis.
